trainer_scp.name: Indigo Plateau Receptionist
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T101 may assist in administrative containment operations. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T101 to cognitohazardous SCPs.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T101 displays exceptional administrative coordination and can stabilize stressed personnel through anomalous calming influence.
addendum_logs: Addendum T101-A: SCP-T101 processed 47 emergency reports in under 10 minutes.
Addendum T101-B: SCP-T101 stabilized a panicked researcher exposed to SCP-0092 (Gastly).

trainer_scp.name: Indigo Plateau Nurse
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T102 may assist in emergency medical response for SCP-related injuries.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T102 displays anomalous healing capabilities far beyond normal medical limits. Multiple identical instances exist, origin unknown.
addendum_logs: Addendum T102-A: SCP-T102 stabilized a researcher injured by SCP-0038 (Ninetales).
Addendum T102-B: Genetic scans show identical structure across all SCP-T102 instances.

trainer_scp.name: Indigo Plateau Security Officer
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T103 must not be exposed to SCP-0142 (Aerodactyl) or SCP-0146 (Moltres).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T103 displays anomalous resilience and rapid hazard response capability, frequently deployed during containment breaches.
addendum_logs: Addendum T103-A: SCP-T103 evacuated personnel during SCP-0142’s aerial breach.
Addendum T103-B: SCP-T103 resisted SCP-0074 (Geodude)’s shockwave with minor injuries.

trainer_scp.name: Indigo Plateau Elite Guard
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid engaging SCP-T104 in combat drills. SCP-T104 must not be exposed to SCP-0149 (Dragonite).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T104 displays elite combat capability and extreme resilience, capable of confronting mid-level SCP entities directly.
addendum_logs: Addendum T104-A: SCP-T104 neutralized SCP-0067 (Machoke) during a breach.
Addendum T104-B: SCP-T104 resisted SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame surge with minimal injury.

Addendum T105-B: SCP-T105 identified a new behavioral trigger in SCP-0049 (Venomoth).

Addendum T106-B: SCP-T106 improved containment strategy for SCP-0068 (Machamp).
